name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: Spreads its children around a ring and walks them around it. Items stay upright and rest under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: The things that orbit. They are spread evenly around the circle.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the orbit starts.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the orbit in pixels.

props.name: path
props.description: Draw the orbit as a thin ring.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Width and height of each orbiting slot in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the orbit and shows the items at rest.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for each orbiting slot.
